title: Monthly board meeting
blurb: The monthly board meeting for the month of January
description: This is the monthly board meeting.
Topics discussed may include a variety of items, such as changes to library policy, staffing needs, upcoming events, etc. These meetings are generally open to the public.

title: Story Time
description: This is the weekly story time.
Story time is open to the public and is intended for young children. The reader is a library volunteer, typically a different person each week.
